title: Why a 50-Year Mortgage Could Trap You
description:
A 50-year mortgage may lower your payment — but it can seriously limit equity and flexibility.

Most homeowners move every 10–12 years. With a 50-year loan, you may barely pay down principal before it’s time to sell, making it harder to build real wealth or exit cleanly.

Longer loans aren’t always smarter — especially in fast-moving markets like Central Texas.
